svg.title: A non-plated hole in a copper pour: pour up to the hole vs pour kept back
svg.desc: Drawn to scale, plan view of a 3.2 mm non-plated hole in a ground pour, twice, with a trace and a via nearby. The mask opening is 0.1 mm larger than the hole in both. Left, marked wrong: the pour runs right up to the hole, so a ring of copper shows at its edge, like the ring of a plated hole. Right, marked right: the pour is kept 0.2 mm back from the hole, so the opening shows a ring of bare FR4 and mask covers the rest of the gap. Enlarged views below show the edge of the hole in each.

g.text: ✗ Pour runs up to the hole
Copper at the edge of the hole
Looks like the ring of a plated hole
Bare FR4 shows: clearly not plated
Drawn to scale. Dimensions in mm.
Non-plated hole 3.2 mm in diameter. Mask opening 0.1 mm larger than the hole.
